connector.name: Clawcall
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for ClawCall - AI-powered US phone calling.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clawcall-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLAWCALL_API_KEY
env.description: Optional ClawCall API key (clawcall_sk_...). Auto-provisioned on the first call if unset; shadows the saved key file when present.

env.name: CLAWCALL_BASE_URL
env.description: ClawCall REST API base URL. Defaults to https://api.clawcall.dev.
